integrity: The coefficient identities are proved analytically and checked with exact rational series; finite numerical Gram comparisons are supplemental, not infinite proofs. No independent audit or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: A strictly local three-tone frequency-collision phase diagram for equal frequency spacing and averaged Lebesgue L2 on [-1,1]. No global gap optimization or arbitrary triples; bibliographic equivalence in older Gram perturbation work remains possible.
title: An interior frequency-splitting transition for three-tone Fourier leverage
